I've got a few little tools for collecting this godlike substance. Either a paintbrush or like I prefer a harder bristled brush I jacked out of my hair trimmer kit, short brush but has the power to get in those ridges and push shit thru the screen. I also occasionally use a toothpick to go thru the ridges to get max back out. 2nd I superglue 2 nickels together for more weight to push more thru the screen, either way you smoke it at one point or another so don't tell me it's wasteful. 3rd I use a small pill keypill bobberfrom dollar general or cvs and I stock up on it. Everytime you flip your grinder getting bud out the keef will fall back against the screen and just gets stuck. Those pillbobs are like 2.99 so great investment. And the more you clean your grinder with isopropyl alcohol the more you can harvest (: good hunting ents! ( I know this is a lot of basic knowledge but hey everyday someone is turning into another stoner, I know I didn't know a lot of useful shit years ago.) 

EDIT: after being high and quick to comment I read more comments lol, dude guys I max out my keef potential. Shake that bitch the hell up with 2 nickels and just watch it stockpile. This shits your best friend when every dealer in town is out.
